styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean premium tech e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, deep charcoal panel #1E1E1E, warm light-wood #D6C3A8, and one vivid product-matched red accent #C8332E; soft neutral-warm studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif type for short headlines and labels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icons; an abstract monochrome milk-splash graphic reserved for hero and closing screens only; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the case always presented as a smooth matte silicone shell bare or fitted on a generic brandless smartphone with a neutral abstract screen, straight edges kept perfectly straight; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
